title: Lighthouse on Cliff
description: A striped lighthouse with a glowing orange and yellow beam stands atop a steep green cliff beside a small white keeper's house with a red roof. The dramatic coastal scene includes scattered buildings on the hillside, rocky outcrops, and the ocean visible below under a purple misty sky.
prompt: A tall red and white striped lighthouse with a bright orange and yellow light beam cutting through the purple misty sky, situated on a steep green grassy cliff with rocky edges. A small white keeper's house with red roof sits beside it. Scattered buildings dot the hillside overlooking the ocean below, in a dramatic painterly digital art style with visible brush strokes.
